summary: The draft is disciplined for the stated scope. It is globally marked `[CONJ-DRAFT]`, repeatedly states that `γ.G3` is conditional on future `γ.B`-chain closure, and does not silently upgrade the result to a closed theorem. Section 2.2 keeps the WTB Thm 19 second-order corollary confined to the Alice-Charlie point-to-point setting, Section 2.3 explicitly flags the Alice-Charlie to Alice-Bob umr transfer as dependent on the open `γ.B` bridge, Section 2.6/2.7 honestly report `γ.G3` as open because of that dependency, and Section 4 states the conditional theorem in the correct `IF γ.B closed THEN γ.G3` form. Citation posture is also aligned with the requested discipline: WTB Thm 19 is presented as a memo-level quote with a PDF-check caveat, Kamin 2025 is treated as a summary/template rather than a verified direct foundation for umr, and there is no silent cross-party transfer or amortized/DPI misapplication inside this draft.
